description: This file defines the NessusOutputProcessor class responsible for parsing Nessus scan report XML files, extracting vulnerabilities, and converting them into internal models for further processing.

classes.name: NessusOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class to process Nessus scan report XML files and extract vulnerabilities into a structured model.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Parses a Nessus XML report file at the given path, extracts vulnerabilities, and returns a ProcessorResult containing these vulnerabilities.
